answer.design_quote: We included randomized controlled trials (RCTs) treating adults with bodily distress using MBCT, MBSR, and ACT compared to inactive and non-specific control groups. A random effects model was used.
answer.k_quote: Sixteen RCTs with 1,288 participants were included in the analysis
